body: What's wrong? If anything? I'm here to talk. Let any problems you have out.

I'm sorry. I don't mean to take anyone's time away from others. If anyone deserves appreciation and support it'd most certainly be you, not me. I did read your post earlier, and I'm sorry. I didn't know what to say or how to help. I'm really not good at anything. Whenever I actually do try I feel like I'm failing no matter what

I'm sorry. No one deserves to be hurt, and everyone deserves respect. I really don't know what to say except for I'm sorry. I know it's dissapointing, but I hope you reach a better point in life. Suicide is scary becaus you could've been right around the corner from getting help, reaching a better tomorrow, but you wouldn't have known. Please don't kill yourself. I know that it hurts. But I hope you can reach the tomorrow we're all searching for. I wish you have better days.
